\endhead
\texttt{CON-01} & \textbf{No automatic discovery of music}. The software shall not search, scrape or match music on streaming services, nor use their APIs or web pages to locate music. Online audio is fetched only from links the user pastes explicitly. \\
\texttt{CON-02} & \textbf{User-declared rights}. Before processing online content the user shall confirm that they own it or are allowed to use it. Audio sources are limited to the user's files, user-supplied video links and catalogues with an explicit Creative Commons licence per item. \\
\texttt{CON-03} & \textbf{No bundled model weights}. The project shall not bundle or host AI model weights; each model is downloaded from its original source after the user accepts its licence. \\
\texttt{CON-04} & \textbf{No commercial audio in the repository}. Tests, examples, screenshots and documentation shall use only synthetic or Creative Commons audio with attribution. \\
\texttt{CON-05} & \textbf{Trademark neutrality}. Third-party service names shall appear only as plain text describing formats or compatibility, without logos and never in the product name. \\
\texttt{CON-06} & \textbf{Platform}. Version 1.0 targets Windows 10/11 64-bit only. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
